title: A planted fake token in the app-token cache blocks every ship
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-15 ~22:00: every krn pr ship (S12, S21, S2 lanes) failed push exit 70 "Invalid username or token"; .krn/tmp/app-cache/krn-app-token.json held a 6-character token expiring 2026-11-17, written 21:59 while lanes ran tests; deleting the cache restored minting.
Outcome: no test or lane process can write the real app-token cache: the cache writer refuses a token that does not look like a GitHub installation token (ghs_ prefix), and a poisoned cache entry is discarded with a stderr line instead of used; the planting test is found and isolated.
Proof: a test plants {token:"abc123"} in KRN_APP_CACHE_DIR and asserts mint ignores it (exit 0, fresh token from the stub) and writeCache refuses a non-ghs_ token.
Files: src/ci/app-token.ts, test/claude/github-app-token.test.ts
